items.evidence: REPRODUCES from 26.1.2. systemic_note: The 1.21.10 tree derives from the 1.21.11 template with deliberate 1.21.10 adaptations (level/ differs from 1.21.11's in exactly 16 files - the B5-scope files). The adaptation fixed the class-name half of the 1.21.7 ledger (8 FIXED: farmland, grass, dirt path, stems, crops, mushrooms, kelp, fletching table) and left the tag half: every defect whose root cause is a tag read survives or worsens, and six NEW major survival defects (G37-G42) come from the port reading supports_* tags 1.21.10 never had while vanilla hardcodes dirt, soul sand, clay, jungle logs and nylium. The absent-tag reads silently degrade to false (data.rs .unwrap_or_default()); 1.21.7 synthesized the supports_* tags but 1.21.10 does not. The 1.21.11 template tree is the repair reference for the tag half; the port's own hardcoded arms (stems, crops, chorus, kelp) show the pattern already established in-tree.
